title: Vedhalam
desc: Ganesh, a taxi driver, leads a peaceful life. One day, upon helping the police seize three criminals, he incurs the wrath of a criminal network, following which his real identity is revealed.

title: Arya
desc: Bizarre events compel a gentleman to pursue his authentic identity. Consequently, these unusual anomalies precipitate this earnest quest.

title: Kadha Parayumbol
desc: Balan, a barber, struggles to give his family a better living. However, his life changes when his old friend, who is a film star, comes to his village for a film shoot.

title: Anjaan
desc: Krishna travels to Mumbai to look for his missing brother Raju. However, things take a turn when he learns that Raju was a notorious gangster in the city.

title: Thalainagaram 2
desc: Right, a former gangster, swears off violence to become a real estate agent. However, he is forced to return to his old ways when three criminals try to frame him for a crime.

title: Odela 2
desc: When a rapist is improperly buried, his ghost begins haunting his village and attacking innocent women. As chaos arises, the villagers look for an answer.
